caption: Diluted blood is pulled through a 100 µm aperture. Each cell gives a resistance pulse; the pulse height sorts red cells, white cells and platelets into separate counts.

spec.title: Coulter counter
spec.aria: Diluted blood is drawn through a small aperture; each cell crossing it produces a resistance pulse that is amplified, sorted by height into red cell, white cell or platelet thresholds, and then counted and plotted as a size histogram.
